name: Blastoff
rootCause: The Blast ecosystem's LaunchPad and yield aggregator BLASTOFF announced that its Future Yield Minter Vault has been hacked, resulting in the theft of approximately 150 ETH (approximately $600,000). The official team has disabled staking in the affected pool and is currently conducting a thorough investigation.

descriptions.text: The Blast ecosystem's LaunchPad and yield aggregator BLASTOFF announced that its Future Yield Minter Vault has been hacked, resulting in the theft of approximately 150 ETH (approximately $600,000). The official team has disabled staking in the affected pool and is currently conducting a thorough investigation.

Blastoff's Future Yield Minter Vault on Blast was exploited on 11 March 2024, resulting in the loss of approximately 150 ETH (about $600,000). Staking was disabled, audits were initiated, and the CEO pledged refunds to affected users. The incident was a protocol logic error affecting the accounting or control mechanism in the Future Yield Minter Vault. Exact contract code and exploit steps have not been disclosed in available sources.
